newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares close lower on speculative selling.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares close lower on speculative selling.

text.p: Speculative selling combined with absence of buying support in volatile trade thumbed share prices to a sharply lower close on the Delhi Stock Exchange, brokers said.
The bourse's benchmark index closed 18.07 points lower at 746.69.
"It appeared that speculators were not interested in holding long positions so they sold at higher levels," said Jagmohan Chadha of brokers Vaibhav Securities.
Reliance Industries closed 7.25 rupees lower at 198.50.
State Bank of India was in the spotlight throughout the day and after touching a mid-session peak of 278.45, it slid to 263.60 rupees -- 3.50 rupees lower than Wednesday's close.
TISCO ended 7.0 rupees lower at 176.25, while ITC closed 6.50 rupees lower at 292.95 on heavy selling towards the end, brokers said.
TELCO lost 12 rupees to 471.50 while Hindustan Lever slipped six rupees to 829 and Larsen and Toubro lost 4.15 rupees at 242.30.
